probe() {
 label="$1"; url="$2"
 start=$(date +%s)
 result=$(timeout 4 wget -S -T 2 -O /dev/null "$url" 2>&1)
 rc=$?
 status=$(printf '%s\n' "$result" | awk 'index($1,"HTTP/")==1 {printf "%s,", $2}')
 printf 'probe=%s start=%s end=%s wget_rc=%s http_status=%s\n' "$label" "$start" "$(date +%s)" "$rc" "$status"
}
